items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Harsh upshifts or engine flare between gears
items.job: Replace shift solenoids and relearn transmission

items.t: Transmission slipping or incorrect gear ratio code
items.job: Diagnose transmission; load pressure data or replace transmission
items.note: Many cases need only the pressure data transfer; a failed clutch means a replacement transmission.

items.t: Airbag warning light from the airbag control unit
items.job: Replace airbag control unit
items.note: Covered by Genesis's 15-year/unlimited-mile warranty extension on this unit.

items.t: Check engine light from a fuel pump module communication error
items.job: Diagnose and repair fuel pump control module wiring or module

items.t: Oil pressure warning light at idle
items.job: Test oil pressure and replace oil pressure switch

items.t: Water pump coolant leak
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $675-$1,015 for a 2017 G80 and $811-$1,115 on average.

items.t: A/C blows warm or cuts out on hot days
items.job: A/C diagnosis; compressor replacement if failed
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,550-$1,655 for a 2018-2020 compressor job; a leak check alone is about $150-$225.

items.t: Seat back panel loose or seat creaks when turning
items.job: Replace seat backboard clip; add tilt pipe retaining ring

items.t: Driveline vibration on AWD 3.8 models
items.job: Measure and adjust driveshaft angles

items.t: Headlights go out or won't dim
items.job: Diagnose headlight circuit; replace switch or module

items.t: Battery keeps going dead
items.job: Parasitic drain test; replace battery if needed
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $634-$651 for a 2017-2020 G80 battery replacement.

items.t: Fuel pump can fail and cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Charging control unit can fail and cut power (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Misfire and check engine light on the 2.5 turbo
items.job: Diagnose misfire; replace spark plugs or ignition coil as needed
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $494-$625 for G80 spark plugs.

items.t: Check engine light for a lean fuel mixture
items.job: Engine computer software update

items.t: Coolant leaking from the radiator reservoir
items.job: Replace radiator reservoir tank and top off coolant

items.t: Tire sidewall failures on 20-inch wheels
items.job: Replace tire (each), mount and balance
items.note: Price is per tire and varies by brand.

items.t: Panoramic sunroof creaks or rattles
items.job: Sunroof noise repair procedure

items.t: Check engine light from the transmission control module
items.job: Diagnose and replace transmission E-module if needed

items.t: Fuel smell after filling up
items.job: Fuel and evaporative system leak check (smoke test)

items.t: Hum or whine from the rear differential
items.job: Inspect and retighten rear differential lock nut

items.t: A/C cools poorly from a refrigerant leak
items.job: Replace evaporator core or A/C line seals, recharge
items.note: Line seals are cheap; an evaporator core is a dashboard-out job. A leak check alone is about $150-$225 per RepairPal.

items.t: Horn stops working
items.job: Replace horns and remount upright

items.t: Battery drains while parked
items.job: Control panel software or module repair; battery test
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $507-$552 for a 2021-2026 G80 battery replacement if the battery is ruined.

items.t: Genesis Connected Services stop working
items.job: Telematics (DCU) software update

items.t: Adaptive cruise brakes or speeds up unexpectedly
items.job: Driver-assist diagnosis and sensor calibration
